ei.title: Local Food and the Carbon Footprint
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Claims that local food production cut greenhouse gas emissions by reducing the burning of transportation fuel are usually not well founded. Transport is the source of only 11 percent of greenhouse gas emissions within the food sector, so reducing the distance that food travels after it leaves the farm is far less important than reducing wasteful energy use on the farm. Food coming from a distance can actually be better for the climate, depending on how it was grown. For example, field-grown tomatoes shipped from Mexico in the winter months will have a smaller carbon footprint than local winter tomatoes grown in a greenhouse. In the United Kingdom, lamb meat that travels 11,000 miles from New Zealand generates only one-quarter the carbon emissions per pound compared to British lamb because farmers in the United Kingdom raise their animals on feed (which must be produced using fossil fuels) rather than on clover pastureland. When food does travel, what matters most is not the distance traveled but the travel mode (surface versus air), and most of all the load size. Bulk loads of food can travel halfway around the world by ocean freight with a smaller carbon footprint, per pound delivered, than foods traveling just a short distance but in much smaller loads. For example, 18-wheelers carry much larger loads than pickup trucks so they can move food 100 times as far while burning only one-third as much gas per pound of food delivered.

지역 겨울 토마토는 멕시코산 밭 재배 토마토보다 탄소 발자국이 항상 더 작다.
대량 적재 화물은 파운드당 더 작은 탄소 발자국으로 세계를 이동할 수 있다.

questions.passage: Claims that local food production cut greenhouse gas emissions by reducing the burning of transportation fuel are usually not well founded. Transport is the source of only 11 percent of greenhouse gas emissions within the food sector, so reducing the distance that food travels after it leaves the farm is far less important than reducing wasteful energy use on the farm. Food coming from a distance can actually be better for the climate, depending on how it was grown. For example, field-grown tomatoes shipped from Mexico in the winter months will have a smaller carbon footprint than local winter tomatoes grown in a greenhouse. In the United Kingdom, lamb meat that travels 11,000 miles from New Zealand generates only one-quarter the carbon emissions per pound compared to British lamb because farmers in the United Kingdom raise their animals on feed (which must be produced using fossil fuels) rather than on clover pastureland. When food does travel, what matters most is not the distance traveled but the travel mode (surface versus air), and most of all the load size. Bulk loads of food can travel halfway around the world by ocean freight with a smaller carbon footprint, per pound delivered, than foods traveling just a short distance but in much smaller loads. For example, 18-wheelers carry much larger loads than pickup trucks so they can move food 100 times as far while burning only one-third as much gas per pound of food delivered.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문과 일치하는 선지 찾기
det.analysis:
✅ ① 일치: 'farmers in the United Kingdom raise their animals on feed (which must be produced using fossil fuels)' — 화석 연료로 생산된 사료로 기름 ← 정답
❌ ② 불일치: 'reducing the distance ... is far less important than reducing wasteful energy use on the farm'
❌ ③ 불일치: 'generates only one-quarter the carbon emissions per pound compared to British lamb' — 오히려 더 적음
❌ ④ 불일치: '18-wheelers carry much larger loads' — 적재량이 더 많음
det.tip: 영국 사료 = 화석 연료로 생산 (clover pastureland 아님)

ch: 영국 농부들은 화석 연료로 생산된 사료로 동물을 기른다.
식품 운송 거리를 줄이는 것이 농장 에너지 절약보다 항상 더 중요하다.
뉴질랜드산 양고기는 영국산 양고기보다 파운드당 탄소 배출이 더 많다.
18륜 트럭은 픽업트럭보다 적재량이 적어 더 적은 연료를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② tomatoes shipping → tomatoes shipped: 토마토가 '수송되는' 수동, 과거분사
det.analysis:
❌ ① coming: 'Food coming from a distance' — 능동 분사(오는) 수식 적절
✅ ② tomatoes shipping → tomatoes shipped: 'field-grown tomatoes shipped from Mexico' — 토마토가 '수송되는' 대상이므로 과거분사 shipped가 맞음. shipping(능동)은 오류 ← 정답
❌ ③ which: 'feed (which must be produced)' — 관계대명사 적절
❌ ④ traveling: 'foods traveling just a short distance' — 능동 분사(이동하는) 수식 적절
det.tip: tomatoes가 수송되는 대상 → shipped (과거분사, 수동)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 탄소 발자국은 거리가 아니라 재배·운송 방식에 달려 있다는 점이 주제
det.analysis:
❌ ① 지역 농산물 구매 윤리: 오히려 로컬푸드 주장을 반박함
❌ ② 온실 재배법: 온실은 예시일 뿐
❌ ③ 식품 무역 제한: 본문과 무관
✅ ④ 식품의 탄소 발자국을 좌우하는 것은 이동 거리가 아니라 재배·운송 방식이라는 점: 운송은 11%뿐이고, 재배 방식·이동 방식·적재량이 핵심이라는 글 전체 논지 ← 정답
det.tip: 거리(X) → 재배 방식·이동 방식·적재량(O)

ch: 지역 농산물을 구매해야 하는 윤리적 이유
온실에서 겨울 채소를 재배하는 효율적인 방법
국가 간 식품 무역을 제한해야 하는 경제적 근거

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 거리보다 재배·운송 방식·적재량이 탄소 발자국을 좌우한다는 요지
det.analysis:
